headline: Like GSP?
caption:
Jon Jones says Gable Steveson is already back training after that 12-second KO, and compares it to GSP losing to Matt Serra 💪
Bounce back or done? 👇

The Olympic champ suffered his first MMA loss to Sean Sharaf at UFC 331. Jones told The Schmo the team needs a lot more sparring and believes Steveson will come back strong. UFC news.

Can Gable still be a UFC heavyweight star?
question: Bounce back or done?

v2.story: Jones says Steveson is back training after his 12-second KO, just like GSP came back from Serra.
v2.question: Bounce back or done?
